yaml:
# Experimental attention backend; retain the standard profile separately.
# NVFP4 weights through Marlin, BF16 activations and KV, A100 SM80.
model: ~/models/r0b0tlab/VibeThinker-3B-NVFP4
served-model-name: r0b0tlab/VibeThinker-3B-NVFP4
host: "127.0.0.1"
port: 8000
dtype: bfloat16
quantization: modelopt_fp4
linear-backend: marlin
kv-cache-dtype: auto
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 65536
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
override-generation-config: '{"max_new_tokens": 16384}'
enable-prefix-caching: true
enable-prompt-tokens-details: true
attention-backend: FLASHINFER
